summary: The comment expresses opposition to limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance as foundational infrastructure for K-12 education. It requests the Commission to focus on modernizing and improving the program rather than questioning its existence.

claims.requested_action: Remove discussion of terminating or significantly limiting the E-Rate program
claims.argument: E-Rate is foundational infrastructure supporting nearly every aspect of modern K-12 education
claims.evidence_quote: While many schools have achieved broadband connectivity through decades of successful E-Rate investments, maintaining that connectivity is an ongoing responsibility-not a completed objective.
